state: Running; fresh restart, launch receipt only, no four-hour acceptance yet
statusCadence: 15-second coordinator aggregation; 30-second per-lane physical sampling; stdin state also saves once per minute

phasesPerLane.name: process
phasesPerLane.end: Actual stdin EOF, exact input digest, natural exit 0

phasesPerLane.name: supervision
phasesPerLane.end: Actual stdin EOF, target exit 23, same-group descendant retains pipes, TERM observed while wait times out, KILL closes group

ownedKeeperPerLane: Separate target imports only the installed public NodeTime and awaits raceExitKeepingAlive(never, 14400000); stdin EOF sent. The target has no other referenced timer or input consumer. It must print false after the real duration and exit cleanly.

payloadPerPhase.burst: Repeated UTF8 BOM + CJK + emoji + CRLF; deliberate one-byte splits in header
payloadPerPhase.pacedOutput: One numbered UTF8/BOM/CRLF frame per channel every 10 seconds until actual input EOF
payloadPerPhase.stdin: A numbered UTF8/BOM/CRLF input write approximately each minute; target receipt hashes actual bytes, not just forwarding acknowledgement
payloadPerPhase.validation: Contiguous per-channel capture offsets, maximum 65536-byte chunks, independent expected byte counts/SHA-256, exact final 4096-byte raw tails and valid UTF8 suffix text

safetyEnvelope.expectedTotalOutput: Less than 26 MiB across both lanes; hard per-lane limits total 32 MiB
safetyEnvelope.globalDuration: 4 hours plus at most 3 minutes before coordinator requests cancellation
safetyEnvelope.onFailure: Reject current lane, request cancellation of both lanes, kill owned sessions/PIDs and preserve all logs
safetyEnvelope.concurrency: Each lane one owned keeper plus one queue target; Supervision adds one group leader; only final cancellation briefly adds one descendant

observations.scope: Only this experiment's known PIDs; ps fields exclude command arguments, lsof emits only PID/FD identifiers
fields: runtime active resource categories when exposed
actual process/capture state and observed/retained channel bytes
observations.meaning: CPU/RSS/FD trends are measured finite-run evidence, not invented production thresholds or a universal no-leak guarantee
observations.nativeCleanup: Require actual target, descendant and supervisor not live after Closed; require own supervision temporary directories absent

limits: Only the two finite runtime queues and this wall-clock interval are exercised
No PTY, daemonized or reparented escape, host crash recovery, disk power-loss or model integration proof
No main source/build or library source changes
Polls, output frames and resource samples are not counted as individual passing tests
